note: Burnt area per year in the EU-27, in thousands of hectares, as mapped by EFFIS (European Forest Fire Information System). Approximate, rounded figures; EFFIS records begin in 2006. EFFIS reprocesses its archive, so a given year's figure can shift by up to ~10% between annual reports (2021, for instance, is 500,566 ha in the 2021 report and 449,342 ha in the 2022 one); these are the values as first reported for each season. 2019 is the one year here not tied to a located primary figure and is the roughest estimate in the series.
